feature: ai-git-cleanup v3: action-first cleanup with one batch confirmation
summary: Rework the shipped ai-git-cleanup skill from analysis-first with interactive gates into action-first automatic cleanup: phase 0 safely migrates to the default branch (auto-stash, ff-only pull on the default branch with HEAD already there), phase 1 classifies branches deterministically in code, phase 2 asks exactly once per delete batch, phase 3 executes and prints the per-branch report — local git only, never zero confirmations.
plain_summary: Say the cleanup phrase and it gets things ready by itself, shows you one list of what it will remove, asks you once, then removes it and tells you what happened.
gating: Work checkpoints in order. Within a checkpoint, the gates run in order: behavior, then ui, then review. A checkpoint is "passed" only when every gate is "passed" or "n/a". Do not start checkpoint N+1 until checkpoint N has passed.

checkpoints.title: Restructure analyze.mjs into migration plan, deterministic classification and batch data
checkpoints.goal: analyze.mjs stays the read-only deterministic engine but emits the v3 shape — a phase-0 migration plan (default-branch detection, dirty/stash steps, ff-only pull pinned to the default branch), protection-filtered classification, the one delete batch with category and evidence, and report data — with the unit and CLI specs reworked to pin the new behavior in its exact configurations.

plain.what: The system works out the whole cleanup on its own, including getting ready first.
plain.why: Without it, cleanup guesses, or asks a model to judge what git can prove.
plain.check: Nothing to see yet, behind the scenes.

tasks: skills/ai-git-cleanup/scripts/analyze.mjs: accept a mode argument (`--all` default, `--sync`, `--branches`) and emit one JSON document containing: `fetchStatus` (unchanged), a `migration` plan (detect default via `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` with main fallback, recorded current branch for the report, auto-stash command `git stash push -m cleanup-auto-stash-<ts>` only when dirty, `git switch <default>`, `git pull --ff-only origin <default>` pinned to the default branch name — never HEAD — and the `git stash pop` step, each with a on-failure WARN-and-continue annotation), the classification/batch/report sections the mode needs; stdout stays a single JSON document.

skills/ai-git-cleanup/scripts/analyze.mjs: rewrite classification — run `git fetch --prune origin` first (fetchStatus as today); protection filter (PROTECTED regex + default branch; never a branch checked out in a linked worktree) runs BEFORE every classification path (L18/R3 fix); then: `git branch --merged <default>` → batch as `-d`; else empty `git diff <default>..<branch>` (tree-identical) → `-D` with evidence 'empty diff vs default'; `[gone]` upstream AND empty diff → `-D` with evidence '[gone] + empty diff'; `[gone]` AND non-empty diff → KEEP (needs review); tracked not-merged → KEEP; local-only → KEEP; any error or uncertainty → KEEP fail-closed, surfaced in the report. Each batch entry carries branch, category, action (`-d`/`-D`), reason/evidence (tip sha or the named evidence), the single-quoted guarded command (`git merge-base --is-ancestor 'refs/heads/<b>' '<default>' && git branch -d '<b>'` for `-d`; `-D` for the empty-diff classes), and its worktreePath.

skills/ai-git-cleanup/scripts/analyze.mjs: absorb the old postSync pull — the phase-0 migration plan carries the ff-only pull pinned to the default branch (R4/L17 fix), post-cleanup keeps only `git worktree prune` (present only when a removal is queued); ahead/behind counts of the default stay report-only, no push ever. Worktree entries keep path/branch/dirty/dirtyFiles/stale/command; dirty worktrees never queue a removal and are flagged as requiring explicit data-loss acknowledgment.

tests/git-cleanup-analyze.spec.ts: rework the classification cases to the new buckets in their exact configurations (R3): merged → `-d`; tree-identical local branch → `-D` 'empty diff vs default'; `[gone]` + empty diff → `-D`; `[gone]` + non-empty diff → KEEP; tracked not-merged → KEEP; local-only → KEEP; protection filter runs before each path (a PROTECTED name that would otherwise match every rule stays keep PROTECTED); default/current/linked-worktree-checked-out never in the batch; fail-closed on broken inventory and missing default; assert every emitted field the consumer relies on (R2) and exact quoted commands (L13).

tests/git-cleanup-analyze.spec.ts: new migration-plan cases — pull command targets the default branch name in a current≠default configuration (R4 pin), stash steps present only when dirty, WARN annotations present for pull-failure and stash-pop-conflict paths, no push string in any command field.

tests/git-cleanup-cli.spec.ts: keep the CLI-contract and fetchStatus cases; replace the old postSync sync-plan describe with mode cases (`--sync` emits migration only, `--branches` skips migration, `--all` default), single-JSON stdout, push-free command scan.
Run bun scripts/gen-assets.ts only if SKILL.md changed (it has not in this checkpoint), then the verify list.
acceptance: One JSON document per run: fetchStatus, migration plan (pull pinned to the default branch, never HEAD), protection-filtered classification, one batch with per-entry category/evidence/guarded single-quoted command, worktrees, and report data.
Every classification branch from the feature spec lands in its exact configuration; any error or uncertainty fails closed to KEEP and appears in the report (R3/R2).
The protection filter runs before every classification path: no PROTECTED, default, or linked-worktree-checked-out branch ever reaches the batch.
No `git push`, reflog GC or remote deletion appears in any emitted command; `-d` entries always carry the merge-base guard.
bun test tests/git-cleanup-analyze.spec.ts and tests/git-cleanup-cli.spec.ts pass; bun run typecheck and bun run lint are clean (only the 3 pre-existing doctor-command warnings).

findings: unit analyze.spec 25/30: :472 tree-identical + :502 gone-empty — cherry-pick same-second sha collision makes tips identical to main so branches are genuinely --merged (code right, fixture premise broken; fix: differing pick via amended message or distinct GIT_COMMITTER_DATE).

unit :524 gone-nonempty — fixture never checks out back to main (HEAD=feature/pushed at analyze time) so CURRENT_BRANCH is correct (protection-before-triage, :340 pin authoritative; fix: checkout main before analyze).
unit :693 worktree prune toEqual — spec's deepPairs helper double-emits every string leaf (object loop pushes primitive child, leaf return re-emits; fix: don't push primitives).
unit :742 report ahead — fixture truth rev-list origin/main..main = 4 (merge --no-ff added 2 before the 2 explicit commits; fix: expect 4).
cli :137 — stale v2 key report.deleteCandidates (fix: report.batch; sibling :157 already asserts batch).

cli :241/:262 CONFLICT — cli.spec demands a 'classification' section (plan task 21 wording) vs analyze-spec header pin (batch/keep/unanalyzed ARE the classification, no separate section). ORCHESTRATOR RULING: the analyze-spec header pin is authoritative; no classification section — rewrite the two mode-scoping assertions against the pinned sections (batch/report present, migration absent for --branches; migration present for --all/default).
flow.spec 0/3 confirmed but NOT gating (not in cp1 verify; plan's regressions map retires old shape in cp2 flow rework).

checkpoints.title: Rewrite SKILL.md as the action-first four-phase flow with flags and triggers
checkpoints.goal: SKILL.md runs phases 0-3 in order — automatic safe migration, deterministic classification, ONE ask per delete batch (the only confirmation), execute and report — supports `--sync`/`--branches`/`--all`, drops `disable-model-invocation` for a trigger-rich description, states the rewritten safety invariants, and the structure gates stay green with the flow spec proving the ordering.

plain.what: One question lists every removal; answering it runs the whole cleanup.
plain.why: Two prompts meant approval could happen without the full plan on screen.
plain.check: Run it on a finished feature: you answer one question before anything changes.

tasks: skills/ai-git-cleanup/SKILL.md: replace analysis-first steps 2-5 with the four phases: Phase 0 automatic migration (record current branch, auto-stash if dirty, switch to default, ff-only pull with HEAD already on the default — WARN and continue on pull failure or stash-pop conflict, leaving the stash in place and reporting it; no ask — all reversible); Phase 1 read-only analyze with the documented mode flag and output fields; Phase 2 the ONE ask per delete batch — batch table (branch, category, reason/evidence), worktree removals that block deletions, dirty-worktree warnings (dirty worktree removal requires explicit data-loss acknowledgment or that branch drops to KEEP), options delete all / pick / stop, nothing destructive before it; Phase 3 execute (worktree removals first, then guarded deletes with exact single-quoting, skip+report failed guards, `git worktree prune` only if a removal happened, no push ever) and end with the per-branch report table (default branch, previous branch, working-tree status incl. stash state, per-branch Action/Reason/Remote/Ahead-Behind).

skills/ai-git-cleanup/SKILL.md frontmatter: remove `disable-model-invocation: true`; rewrite the folded `>-` description as trigger-rich (tidy up, tidy branches, sync to main, delete old branches, start fresh, limpieza de branches — auto-invoked by phrase) while keeping name, LicenseRef-Attributed and the minimum structure; document the flags `--sync` (phase 0 only), `--branches` (phases 1-3, no migration), `--all` (default). Keep the `## Lifecycle` block and the Trail of Bits `Source:` line untouched.

skills/ai-git-cleanup/SKILL.md: rewrite the Safety invariants — 1-batch-ask floor (never zero confirmations for deletions), protected-before-triage (R3), pinned sync target (R4: pull names the default branch, never HEAD), single-quoting of all refnames/paths, dirty-worktree refusal without per-worktree acknowledgment, unanalyzed/uncertain → KEEP fail-closed surfaced in the report, deletions only in the main session; no push, no reflog GC, no CI, no remote deletion.

tests/git-cleanup-flow.spec.ts: rework to the new contract (R2/R3) — phase 0 pull pinned to the default in a current≠default fixture (R4), removal-before-delete ordering with the candidate↔worktree back-link, exactly one ask before any destructive command in SKILL.md, protection-before-triage in the emitted document, dirty refusal outranking ordering, no push anywhere.
Run bun scripts/gen-assets.ts after the SKILL.md edits, then the verify list (skills/workflow-handoff/embed-canon structure gates: folded description, SPDX, Lifecycle, Source line, link integrity).
acceptance: SKILL.md describes phases 0-3 in order with exactly one `ask` before any deletion; migration runs with no ask because it is fully reversible.
Frontmatter has no disable-model-invocation, keeps name=folder, folded description with the trigger phrases, LicenseRef-Attributed, the Lifecycle block and the Trail of Bits Source line.
The three flags are documented with their phase scopes; `--all` is the default.
Safety invariants state the 1-ask floor, protected-before-triage, pinned sync target, quoting, dirty refusal, fail-closed KEEP and main-session-only deletion.

bun test tests/git-cleanup-flow.spec.ts, tests/git-cleanup-analyze.spec.ts, tests/git-cleanup-cli.spec.ts, tests/skills.spec.ts, tests/workflow-handoff.spec.ts and tests/embed-canon.spec.ts pass; bun run typecheck and bun run lint are clean.

checkpoints.title: Close the loop: report, obsolete reference removal, docs sweep and full green
checkpoints.goal: The run ends with the per-branch report proven end to end, references/merge-evidence.md is removed with attribution preserved in NOTICE, CHANGELOG and the changeset carry the v3 entry, assets are regenerated, and the full suite is green at the new baseline.

plain.what: After a cleanup you get a clear summary of every branch and what happened to it.
plain.why: Without the report, silent skips and refusals are invisible after the run ends.
plain.check: Run a cleanup and read the final table: every branch has an action and a reason.

assumptions: Worktree-batch clarification (resolves acceptance-3 vs test-plan U15/U19): a linked worktree's branch reaches the batch WITH its worktreePath back-link when the worktree is CLEAN and stale (phase 3 removes the worktree first, then deletes — the one ask covers both); a DIRTY worktree's branch never reaches the batch (requiresAcknowledgment, drops to KEEP). Acceptance-3 forbids batched worktree-held branches only in the dirty/unacknowledged sense.
Scope is git only, the skill keeps the name ai-git-cleanup, and automation is auto with one batch confirmation — user decisions already made (feature request).

Phase 0's pull failure only WARNs and cleanup continues: the reference's STOP is a deviation the feature request logged as an assumption, because cleanup does not need a synced default (feature request).
